e.title: **把「一份文档怎么变成可问的东西」拆成可独立替换的几段，并说明这条组合是固定的**：一个精算与保险研究的文档情报平台**逐字写明每一段都锚在「**共享的领域服务与**稳定的 JSON 任务或资源契约**」上**，**因而逐字「**React 界面、**内置流水线与外部自动化**用的是同一份输入输出」**；**并逐字给这条流水线定了性**——**「**这条内置的接力**是**有意设计成一条固定的、可观察的组合**，**而不是一个通用的 DAG 编辑器」**
e.title_en: Splitting how a document becomes something you can ask into separately replaceable stages and stating that the composition is fixed: a document-intelligence platform for actuarial and insurance research states verbatim that every stage rests on a shared domain service and a stable JSON task or resource contract, so that the interface, the built-in pipeline and external automation use the same inputs and outputs, and characterises the pipeline verbatim as an intentionally fixed and observable composition rather than a general directed-acyclic-graph editor
e.title_hk: **把「一份文檔怎麼變成可問的東西」拆成可獨立替換的幾段，並說明這條組合是固定的**：一個精算與保險研究的文檔情報平台**逐字寫明每一段都錨在「**共享的領域服務與**穩定的 JSON 任務或資源契約**」上**，**因而逐字「**React 界面、**內置流水線與外部自動化**用的是同一份輸入輸出」**；**並逐字給這條流水線定了性**——**「**這條內置的接力**是**有意設計成一條固定的、可觀察的組合**，**而不是一個通用的 DAG 編輯器」**
e.summary: 一份**面向精算与保险研究的文档情报平台**（**★3**、Python、仓库体量 7.5 MB、**实测 README 16,576 字节且中英各一份**）：**逐字自述为**「**一个 FastAPI ＋ React 的文档情报平台**，**它**会**发现、下载、编目、转换、检索**，**并**与公开网页文档和浏览器上传的本地文件对话**」**；**其最值得记的一处是它**把「可替换的边界」写清****——**逐字「**只要保持阶段契约，**一个采集器、转换引擎、分类器、分块器、嵌入提供方、知识库索引／就绪数据构建器或对话检索策略**都可以被独立替换或升级」**；**第二处是它**把这条组合刻意定成固定的****——**逐字「**这条内置的接力是**有意设计成一条固定的、可观察的组合**，**而不是一个通用的 DAG 编辑器」**；**第三处是它**把「退役」也写进状态节****（**逐字「**旧的服务端渲染／Replit 时代的工作流**已退役」**，**并逐字说明 **FastAPI 是唯一的 `/api/*` 权威、**React／Vite 是唯一维护中的界面**），**以及**逐字声明**「受管路线图已无未合并 PR」**
e.summary_hk: 一份**面向精算與保險研究的文檔情報平台**（**★3**、Python、體量 7.5 MB、**實測 README 16,576 位元組且中英各一份**）：**逐字自述為**「**一個 FastAPI ＋ React 的文檔情報平台**，**它會**發現、下載、編目、轉換、檢索**，**並**與公開網頁文檔和瀏覽器上傳的本地文件對話」**；**其最值得記的一處是它**把「可替換的邊界」寫清****——**逐字「**只要保持階段契約，**一個採集器、轉換引擎、分類器、分塊器、嵌入提供方、**知識庫索引／就緒數據構建器或對話檢索策略**都可以被獨立替換或升級」**；**第二處是它**把這條組合刻意定成固定的****——**逐字「**這條內置的接力是**有意設計成一條固定的、可觀察的組合**，**而不是一個通用的 DAG 編輯器」**；**第三處是它**把「退役」也寫進狀態節****（**逐字「**舊的服務端渲染／Replit 時代的工作流**已退役」**，**並逐字說明 **FastAPI 是唯一的 `/api/*` 權威、**React／Vite 是唯一維護中的界面**），以及**逐字聲明**「受管路線圖已無未合併 PR」**
e.summary_en: A document-intelligence platform for actuarial and insurance research — 3 stars, Python, a 7.5 MB repository, with a README measured at 16,576 bytes in both English and Chinese — describing itself verbatim as a FastAPI and React document-intelligence platform that discovers, downloads, catalogs, converts, searches and chats with public web documents and browser-uploaded local files. **Its most notable feature is that it writes down where replacement is possible**: verbatim, so long as the stage contract is preserved, a collector, conversion engine, classifier, chunker, embedding provider, knowledge-base index or ready-data builder, or chat retrieval strategy can be replaced or upgraded independently. **The second is that it deliberately settles the composition as fixed**, verbatim that this built-in baton is intentionally a fixed and observable composition rather than a general graph editor. **The third is that retirement is written into the status section**, verbatim that the legacy server-rendered workflow is retired, alongside verbatim statements that one service is the only authority for the API surface and one framework the only maintained interface, and that the managed roadmap has no open pull requests left.
e.body:
**ai-actuarial-info-search**（仓库 `ferryhe/AI_actuarial_inforsearch`）**是一份面向精算与保险研究的文档情报平台**：**逐字自述为**「**AI Actuarial Info Search is a FastAPI + React document-intelligence platform for actuarial and insurance research. It discovers, downloads, catalogs, converts, searches, and chats with public web documents and browser-uploaded local files.**」**。**实测 **★3**、fork 0、许可字段为 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信号一致，见下**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 **7,520 KB**、**创建 2026-01-27**、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**⭐ 推送落在解冻窗口之内**）**；**README 实测 **16,576 字节**，**且**另有简体中文版（`README.zh-CN.md`）**；**其正文含 **17 个二级小节**与一份**指向 11 份文档的索引**（**逐字含「架构」「**死代码与质量门」「**API 迁移状态」「**Agentic RAG 指南」「**生产安全配置」与「**归档的历史文档」**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「源与生成物」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「哪一段可以被换掉」写得最清楚的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把每一段锚在**同一份契约**上，因而**界面、内置流水线与外部自动化**三者等价**——**逐字为**：**「**All core workflow capabilities are exposed as **independently callable CLI and/or API operations**. Each processing stage is backed by a **shared domain service and a stable JSON task or resource contract**, so **the React UI, the built-in pipeline, and external automation use the same inputs and outputs.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「同一份输入输出」是本条**最符合本轮主题的一句****——**⭐ 即**界面**不是唯一入口，**而**流水线**也不是黑箱**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **契约是**任务或资源**两类**（**逐字 `JSON task or resource`**）**——**⭐ 即**「要做一件事」与「要看一件东西」**被分成两种契约**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **三个消费者被逐个点名**（**界面／**内置流水线／**外部自动化**）**——**⭐ 即**「可被外部编排」**不是暗示，**而是明写****；**④ ⭐⭐ **它给出**新采集器的最小接入方式****（**逐字「**一个新采集器可以实现公共的 `BaseCollector` 输入输出契约——**或者**一个外部生产者可以发出**同样的存储文件与元数据契约**——**而**不必改动 Markdown 转换或之后的任何阶段」**）**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把这条组合刻意定成**固定的、可观察的**，并说明不做什么**——**逐字为**：**「**This built-in baton is **intentionally a fixed, observable composition rather than a general DAG editor**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「固定的、可观察的组合」是一个**拒绝提供通用编排**的决定****——**⭐ 本词条认为这一句很值得抄：**它把「不做通用 DAG 编辑器」**写成了一条设计结论**，**而不是**待办事项****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「可替换」与「固定」并不矛盾**（**段落可换，**而**连接顺序固定**）**——**⭐ 即**它把**灵活性的位置**限定在**段内**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它随后给出**这条固定接力的完整顺序****（**逐字：**定时采集 → Markdown → **编目／分类 → **分块 ＋ 嵌入 → **知识库成员与绑定 → **知识库索引 ＋ 就绪数据 → **对话知识库**）**——**⭐ 即**读者**可以照这条线**核对产物**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字说明**升级为什么是局部的****——**逐字为**：**「**This separation keeps future upgrades local: **a collector, conversion engine, classifier, chunker, embedding provider, KB index/Ready Data builder, or Chat retrieval strategy can be replaced or upgraded independently as long as it preserves the stage contract.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **七个可替换位置被逐个点名**（**采集器／**转换引擎／**分类器／**分块器／**嵌入提供方／**索引与就绪数据构建器／**检索策略**）**——**⭐ 即**「可替换」有**具体清单**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **条件只有一个**（**「只要保持阶段契约」**）**——**⭐ 即**约束被写成一个**准入条件**，**而不是一堆规范**；**③ ⭐⭐ **「让未来的升级保持局部」是**理由**（**⭐ 即**拆段的动机**被说明**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **它的状态节把**退役**与**路线图完成**同样当成事实来报**——**逐字含**：**「**FastAPI is the only `/api/*` authority; React/Vite is the only maintained product UI. **The legacy server-rendered/Replit-era workflow is retired.**」**，**以及**「**Roadmap completion:** Agentic RAG PRs **#133-#145**、consolidation PRs **#147-#154**、managed Feishu-plan PR-A through PR-I（**#156-#164**）are merged; **there are no open managed-roadmap PRs.**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **「退役」被写成状态的一行**（**⭐ 即**拆掉的东西**也进状态栏**）；**② ⭐⭐ **权威被收敛到一处**（**逐字「唯一的 `/api/*` 权威」**）**——**⭐ 即**同一功能**不允许有两个入口**；**③ ⭐⭐ **路线图完成度用**合并的 PR 区间**证明**（**⭐ 即**读者可以**去核对那些 PR**）**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **安全态势一节逐条给出，且多是**可检查的机制****——**逐字含**：**「**Chat/RAG selected-document context is **bounded and marked untrusted** before it reaches the model」**、「**Public URL fetching checks **unsafe schemes, private/reserved IPs, redirect target changes, and DNS/IP drift**」**、「**Browser auth pages show friendly rate-limit and system-error messages **without exposing internals**」**，**以及**「**诊断密钥与凭据状态**而不打印密钥值」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **上下文被**界定范围并标记为不可信**（**⭐ 即**「把外部文档喂给模型」**这件事的**风险处理**被写出来**）；**② ⭐⭐ **对公网取数检查**重定向目标变化与 DNS／IP 漂移**（**⭐ 即**它防的不只是首跳**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **报错不暴露内部**与**诊断不打印密钥**是两条**面向运维的约束****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **文档转换由一份 YAML 配置驱动**，**且**逐字说明**付费／API 工具默认**不会被自动选中****（**逐字「paid/API tools are not auto-selected by default」**）**——**⭐ 即**默认不花钱**是一个默认值决策**；**② **去重用 **SHA-256**，**并**增量编目**摘要、关键词与分类**；**③ **周更摘要用一个**首次见到时间**字段**（**逐字 `files.first_seen`**），**默认任务用**上一整周**（**逐字 `relative_period: previous_week`**）**；**④ **标准向量 RAG 与 Agentic RAG **并存**；**⑤ **它有**中英两份 README****（**⭐ 即**同一份说明**有两个语言版本**）**；**⑥ **其文档索引里把**死代码与质量门**单列一份文档**（**⭐ 即**清理**也被当成一项有记录的工程**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[firecrawl]]、[[llamaindex]]、[[chroma]]、[[ragas]]、[[langfuse]]、[[mineru]]、[[label-studio]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信号一致指向**没有许可声明****：**GitHub 许可字段为 **NONE****、**实测根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在**（**raw 探测均为 HTTP 404**）、**且 README 全文以「licen／copyright／©」检索**零命中****——**⭐ 本词条指出：**这是一份**会把公开网页文档与用户上传文件读进去**的平台，**而「可以读到」与「可以再分发」是两件事****。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有安装或运行它的任何一步****——**未安装 Python／Node 依赖、未启动服务、未跑 `pytest`、未配置任何模型密钥、未采集任何站点、未打开其界面**；**故**本词条**不主张**其采集、转换、编目、分块、嵌入、索引或检索**按其所述工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的**逐字内容**（**含其 17 小节与 11 份文档索引**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读其任何源码或那 11 份文档****（**⭐ 即**未核对**阶段契约是否确实统一、**「不再有未合并的受管路线图 PR」是否属实、**以及**安全态势那几条是否在代码里落实**）**——**⭐ 这是本条目**最需要后续核实的一处**。**④ ⚠️ **★3**（**为本轮四条中关注度最高的一条**）、**fork 0**，**且**未核实作者背景**。**⑤ ⚠️ **创建在解冻窗口之前（2026-01-27）****，**入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-10）**。**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其检索结果在任何精算用途上可依赖**（**⭐ 其自述**未给出任何质量指标**，**本词条**也不据其词「就绪数据」推断质量**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/ferryhe/AI_actuarial_inforsearch` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可字段 NONE、语言、体量、创建／推送时间）；README **16,576 字节**经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**含其 17 个二级小节标题、安全态势一节与 11 份文档索引**）；根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 的存在经 raw 探测确认（均为 HTTP 404）；**⭐ 另经 `/search/issues` 实测读到其 2026-09-09 的两条 PR；**未克隆、未安装任何依赖、未运行任何命令或测试、未启动任何服务、未读任何源码或文档内容、未做其他网络观察**。

The legacy server-rendered/Replit-era workflow is retired.**」與「**Roadmap completion:** Agentic RAG PRs **#133-#145**、consolidation PRs **#147-#154**、managed Feishu-plan PR-A through PR-I（**#156-#164**）are merged; **there are no open managed-roadmap PRs.**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐「退役」被寫成狀態的一行**（拆掉的東西也進狀態欄）；**② ⭐⭐權威被收斂到一處**（逐字「唯一的 `/api/*` 權威」——同一功能不允許有兩個入口）；**③ ⭐⭐路線圖完成度用**合併的 PR 區間**證明**（讀者可以去核對那些 PR）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **安全態勢一節逐條給出，且多是**可檢查的機制****——逐字含「Chat/RAG selected-document context is **bounded and marked untrusted** before it reaches the model」、「Public URL fetching checks **unsafe schemes, private/reserved IPs, redirect target changes, and DNS/IP drift**」、「Browser auth pages show friendly rate-limit and system-error messages **without exposing internals**」，以及「診斷密鑰與憑據狀態而不打印密鑰值」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐上下文被界定範圍並標記為不可信**；**② ⭐⭐對公網取數檢查**重定向目標變化與 DNS／IP 漂移**（防的不只是首跳）；**③ ⭐⭐報錯不暴露內部**與**診斷不打印密鑰**是兩條面向運維的約束。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 其餘**：文檔轉換由一份 YAML 配置驅動，且逐字說明**付費／API 工具預設不會被自動選中**（「paid/API tools are not auto-selected by default」——**預設不花錢**是一個預設值決策）；去重用 **SHA-256** 並增量編目摘要、關鍵詞與分類；週更摘要用一個**首次見到時間**字段（`files.first_seen`），預設任務用**上一整週**（`relative_period: previous_week`）；標準向量 RAG 與 Agentic RAG **並存**；有**中英兩份 README**；其文檔索引把**死代碼與質量門**單列一份（清理也被當成一項有記錄的工程）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 可與 [[firecrawl]]、[[llamaindex]]、[[chroma]]、[[ragas]]、[[langfuse]]、[[mineru]]、[[label-studio]] 並讀**。

**ai-actuarial-info-search** (repository `ferryhe/AI_actuarial_inforsearch`) **is a document-intelligence platform for actuarial and insurance research**, describing itself verbatim as a document-intelligence platform built on a Python web framework and a React front end that discovers, downloads, catalogs, converts, searches and chats with public web documents and browser-uploaded local files. **Measured 3 stars, 0 forks, a licence field of NONE** — ⚠️ three signals agreeing, as set out below — **primary language Python, a 7,520 KB repository, created 2026-01-27, last pushed 2026-09-10** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **the push falls inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 16,576 bytes**, with a simplified-Chinese counterpart also present, **and its body carries seventeen second-level sections and an index pointing at eleven documents**, including documents named verbatim for architecture, dead code and quality gates, API migration status, the agentic retrieval guide, production security configuration and archived historical notes. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **source and generated artefact**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it states most clearly which parts may be replaced**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It anchors every stage on the same contract, so the interface, the built-in pipeline and external automation are equivalent** — verbatim, all core workflow capabilities are exposed as independently callable command-line or interface operations, each processing stage is backed by a shared domain service and a stable JSON task or resource contract, **so that the interface, the built-in pipeline and external automation use the same inputs and outputs** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the same inputs and outputs is the line here that best fits the round’s theme, since the interface is not the only entry point and the pipeline is not a black box**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the contract comes in two kinds, a task and a resource**, ⭐ **so doing something and looking at something are two separate contracts**; ⭐⭐⭐ **three consumers are named one by one, the interface, the built-in pipeline and external automation, so being externally orchestratable is stated rather than implied**; **and ⭐⭐ the smallest way to add a collector is given**, verbatim that a new collector can implement a common base contract **or that an external producer can emit the same stored-file and metadata contract without changing conversion or any later stage**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It deliberately fixes the composition and says what it is not** — verbatim, this built-in baton is **intentionally a fixed and observable composition rather than a general graph editor** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **a fixed and observable composition is a decision to refuse general orchestration**, ⭐ **and this entry considers the sentence worth copying, since it writes not building a general graph editor as a design conclusion rather than a backlog item**; ⭐⭐⭐ **replaceable and fixed do not contradict each other, since the segments may change while the order of connection stays fixed**, ⭐ **the location of flexibility being confined inside the segments**; **and ⭐⭐ the full order of the fixed baton is then given**, from scheduled collection through conversion, cataloguing, chunking and embedding, knowledge-base binding, index and ready-data building to the chat knowledge base. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It states verbatim why upgrades stay local** — verbatim, this separation keeps future upgrades local, **a collector, conversion engine, classifier, chunker, embedding provider, knowledge-base index or ready-data builder, or chat retrieval strategy being replaceable or upgradeable independently as long as the stage contract is preserved** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **seven replaceable positions are named one by one, so replaceability has a concrete list**; ⭐⭐⭐ **there is exactly one condition, preserving the stage contract, so the constraint is written as an admission requirement rather than a specification**; **and ⭐⭐ the reason, keeping future upgrades local, is given.** **④ ⭐⭐ Its status section reports retirement and roadmap completion as facts of the same kind** — verbatim, one service is the only authority for the interface surface and one framework the only maintained product interface, **and the legacy server-rendered workflow is retired**, together with verbatim statements that several pull-request ranges are merged and **that there are no open managed-roadmap pull requests** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **retirement is one line of status, so what was taken away enters the status bar too**; ⭐⭐ **authority is narrowed to one place**, ⭐ **so the same capability may not have two entry points**; **and ⭐⭐ roadmap completion is evidenced by merged pull-request ranges, which a reader can go and check.** **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its security section lists mechanisms, most of them checkable** — verbatim, chat context from selected documents is **bounded and marked untrusted before it reaches the model**, public URL fetching checks **unsafe schemes, private and reserved addresses, redirect target changes and DNS or IP drift**, browser authentication pages show friendly rate-limit and system-error messages **without exposing internals**, **and credential state can be diagnosed without printing secret values** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **context is both bounded and marked untrusted, so the risk of feeding external documents to a model is handled explicitly**; ⭐⭐ **the fetch checks cover redirect target changes and address drift, so it defends against more than the first hop**; **and ⭐⭐ not exposing internals in errors and not printing secrets in diagnostics are two operational constraints.** **⑥ ⭐⭐ Other details**: **conversion is driven by a YAML configuration**, and paid or API-backed tools are stated verbatim **not to be auto-selected by default**, ⭐ **so not spending money by default is a default-value decision**; **deduplication uses a cryptographic hash with incremental cataloguing of summaries, keywords and categories**; **weekly summaries rest on a first-seen field with the default task covering the previous whole week**; **standard vector retrieval and agentic retrieval coexist**; **the readme exists in two languages**; **and its documentation index gives dead code and quality gates a document of their own**, ⭐ **so cleanup counts as recorded engineering**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[firecrawl]], [[llamaindex]], [[chroma]], [[ragas]], [[langfuse]], [[mineru]] and [[label-studio]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Three signals agree that there is no licence statement**: **the GitHub licence field is NONE**, **neither a licence file nor a licence markdown file exists at the root, both raw probes returning 404**, **and the readme returns no hit for licence, copyright or the copyright sign** — ⭐ **the entry notes that this is a platform which reads public web documents and user-uploaded files, and that being readable and being redistributable are two different things**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was installed or run** — **no Python or Node dependency installed, no service started, no test run, no model key configured, no site collected and no interface opened**; **so this entry does not claim its collection, conversion, cataloguing, chunking, embedding, indexing or retrieval works as described**, ⭐ **what it verified being the verbatim readme, including its seventeen sections and eleven-document index**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ Neither its source nor those eleven documents were read**, ⭐ **so whether the stage contracts are really uniform, whether the claim of no open managed-roadmap pull requests is true, and whether the security mechanisms are implemented in code were not checked** — ⭐ **the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **④ ⚠️ At 3 stars, the highest-attention entry of this round, with no forks, the author’s background was not verified**. **⑤ ⚠️ It was created before the thaw window, on 2026-01-27**, **selection resting on the push falling inside the window on 2026-09-10**. **⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its retrieval results are dependable for any actuarial purpose**, ⭐ **the repository giving no quality figures, and this entry drawing no inference from its phrase ready data**. **⑦ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence field, language, size and dates; the 16,576-byte readme was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, **including its seventeen section headings, its security section and its eleven-document index**; licence file probes against the root returned 404; **two pull requests dated 2026-09-09 were additionally read through the issue search endpoint**; **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no command or test was run, no service was started, no source or documentation content was read, and no other network observation was made**.
